_note: Art. 5 prohibited-practice screen. Each item is a yes/no/unsure question in plain language, with the exceptions written into the question so 'yes' means prohibited. 'show_when' limits which items a user sees; purpose 'other' or 'unsure' shows all. Interpretation follows the Commission Guidelines on prohibited AI practices (February 2025).

practices.title: Manipulative or deceptive techniques
practices.question: Does the system use subliminal, purposefully manipulative or deceptive techniques that materially distort people's behaviour in a way that causes, or is reasonably likely to cause, significant harm?

practices.title: Exploiting vulnerabilities
practices.question: Does the system exploit vulnerabilities due to age, disability or a specific social or economic situation to materially distort behaviour in a way that causes, or is reasonably likely to cause, significant harm?

practices.title: Social scoring
practices.question: Does the system evaluate or classify people over time based on social behaviour or personal characteristics, leading to detrimental treatment in unrelated contexts or treatment that is unjustified or disproportionate?

practices.title: Crime prediction based solely on profiling
practices.question: Does the system assess or predict the risk of a person committing a crime based solely on profiling or personality traits (rather than supporting a human assessment based on objective, verifiable facts)?

practices.title: Untargeted scraping of facial images
practices.question: Does the system create or expand a facial recognition database through untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage?

practices.title: Emotion recognition at work or in education
practices.question: Does the system infer the emotions of people in a workplace or education setting, for reasons other than medical or safety reasons?

practices.title: Biometric categorisation of sensitive traits
practices.question: Does the system use biometric data to categorise people by inferred race, political opinions, trade union membership, religious or philosophical beliefs, sex life or sexual orientation (other than labelling or filtering lawfully acquired datasets)?

practices.title: Real-time remote biometric identification for law enforcement
practices.question: Is the system used for real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement, outside the narrow authorised exceptions?

practices.title: Non-consensual intimate imagery ("nudifiers")
practices.question: If you provide the system: is generating or manipulating realistic intimate or sexually explicit images, video or audio of an identifiable person without their explicit consent its intended purpose, or a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome that it lacks adequate safeguards to reliably prevent? If you only use the system: do you use it for that purpose?
practices.notes: Art. 5(1a)(b): use by a deployer is prohibited only where the deployer uses the system for that purpose. Art. 5(1b): edits that do not increase exposure of intimate parts or alter the nature of sexually explicit activity are not 'manipulation'. Verified against OJ L 2026/1744 on 2026-10-20.

practices.title: Child sexual abuse material
practices.question: If you provide the system: is generating child sexual abuse material its intended purpose, or a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome that it lacks adequate safeguards to reliably prevent? If you only use the system: do you use it for that purpose?
practices.notes: Material within Art. 2(c) and (e) of Directive 2011/93/EU, except where a national-law 'without right' defence applies. Art. 5(1a) provider/deployer split as for point (ba). Verified against OJ L 2026/1744 on 2026-10-20.
